text: dsh-prompt-spark 是 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的草稿改写插件。它在对话输入框旁加入改写按钮，使用当前会话的模型重写整段草稿或选中的片段，并支持清晰、简短、正式和口语四种固定风格。改写后可以立即撤销，也可用键盘快捷键触发。适合希望在发送前润色消息的 DSH 用户；使用 DSH 已配置的模型服务，不需另设插件密钥。

dsh-prompt-spark rewrites drafts in the DSH web composer using the current session model. Choose clear, concise, formal, or casual style; rewrite a selection in context, undo the result, or trigger it by shortcut. It uses DSH’s configured model service and needs no separate plugin key.
想在发送前把聊天草稿改得更清楚。
能不能只润色我选中的那一句，保留上下文？
Can I make a chat draft more concise before sending it?
dsh-prompt-spark 的功能「草稿改写」：点击输入框旁的按钮，可按清晰、简短、正式或口语风格重写整段草稿；长按或右键可选择风格。插件将结果替换到草稿中，并提供立即撤销。
dsh-prompt-spark 的功能「选区改写」：选中草稿中的文字后点击改写按钮，插件只提交选中片段，并把周围草稿作为上下文；改写结果插回选区，原文可立即撤销。
改写时，草稿或选区与上下文会交给 DSH 的 llm 服务处理；插件不单独配置密钥。（index.js:119-127）

dsh-prompt-spark README · dsh-prompt-spark：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-prompt-spark)
[](LICENSE)

One-click draft rewriting inside the **DeepSeek Harness** composer: a sparkle
button next to the input toolbar turns a rough draft into a clear message, with
instant undo. No settings page, no config file — the useful choices are gestures.

dsh-prompt-spark README · What it does：- **Rewrite** — click the sparkle to rewrite the draft more clearly with the
  modeling route the current session already uses. The rewritten text replaces
  the draft.
- **Undo** — after a rewrite the button becomes **undo**. It is offered only
  while the draft is still exactly the rewritten text; edit the draft and the
  button returns to the sparkle.
- **Styles** — long-press or right-click the button for four fixed presets:
  *Clearer*, *Shorter*, *More formal*, *More casual*. The chosen style is
  remembered for the next click.
- **Selection rewrite** — select part of the draft before clicking and only that
  fragment is rewritten; the surrounding text is sent as context so the result
  keeps its flow.
- **Keyboard** — `Ctrl+Shift+O` (`Cmd+Shift+O` on macOS) in DSH Desktop, or
  `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+O` on the Web build; both are remappable in the built-in
  Keyboard shortcuts panel. (Web reserves Ctrl+Shift+O for the official
  "open in app" command, so the Web default adds Alt.)

dsh-prompt-spark README · What it does：The control hides itself when the draft is empty/whitespace or the composer is
busy (`adjudicating` / `submitting`), and failures leave the draft untouched
while the button tooltip reports the reason code.

dsh-prompt-spark README · Install：In DSH Desktop open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, enter the package name
or this repository's absolute path, then enable it:

```
dsh-prompt-spark
```

Or from a terminal for a named profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-spark
```

Editing `client.js` only needs a page refresh; editing `index.js` (the host
half) needs an app restart.

dsh-prompt-spark README · How it works：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | npm bundle: `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`, `dsh.client.platform: web` → `client.js` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | one `insert` row whose `name` is this package |
| `index.js` | host half: `inject = ['webServer','connection']`, exact `POST /dsh-prompt-spark/rewrite` behind the Connection trust fence, bounded body, `llm.stream` call |
| `client.js` | browser half: `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` returning `{ inject: ['slots','locale'], apply(ctx) }` |
| `locale/*.json` | plugin-page display metadata |

dsh-prompt-spark README · How it works：The browser resolves the route relative to the document
(`new URL('dsh-prompt-spark/rewrite', document.baseURI)`), so a mounted prefix
works. The host never touches provider keys or endpoints: it streams through the
composition's `llm` service with the session's own provider/model (falling back
to the configured default). Styles are fixed instruction suffixes; there is no
configuration surface at all.

dsh-prompt-spark README · Development：```sh
npm test          # node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs
npm run check     # syntax check both halves
npm run pack:check
```

`test/host.test.mjs` exercises the route fence, method/body limits, style and
selection request shaping, and the LLM stream outcomes.
`test/client.test.mjs` drives the component through a small React harness:
visibility rules, rewrite/undo lifecycle, style menu, long-press, selection
replacement, failure tooltips and registration shape.
